h:
使用此工作流程，您可以创建超清晰的动漫图像。它可能无法与 Comradeship XL v14KC 型号以外的 ILXL 型号正常工作。

此工作流程需要 2x-AnimeSharpV4。在此下载 2x-AnimeSharpV4。

https://huggingface.co/Kim2091/2x-AnimeSharpV4/blob/main/2x-AnimeSharpV4_RCAN.safetensors

o.en:
Using this workflow, you can create super clear anime images. It may not work properly with ILXL models other than the Comradeship XL v14KC model.

This workflow requires 2x-AnimeSharpV4. Download 2x-AnimeSharpV4 here.

https://huggingface.co/Kim2091/2x-AnimeSharpV4/blob/main/2x-AnimeSharpV4_RCAN.safetensors
